question: Should `policy watch --interval-ms` preserve numerically equivalent `+500` and zero-padded spellings, or intentionally require canonical decimal text?
rationale: Current behavior accepts these spellings and the documented boundary is numeric rather than textual, so source inspection cannot authorize the compatibility break.

options.title: Preserve existing spellings
options.body: Remove the canonical-string equality check and retain the established safe-integer and minimum-value validation.

options.title: Require canonical decimal
options.body: Approve the compatibility break, document canonical syntax, and require supported-Node real CLI proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing spellings
recommendation.body: Remove the canonical-string equality check and retain the established safe-integer and minimum-value validation.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged Policy CLI and are the strongest available feature-history owner for its accepted-input contract.
